title.en: Excluding Cement From the List of Export Products Subject to Duty Provided for Under Republic Act No. 1937, Otherwise Known as the "Tariff and Customs Code", as Amended

text.en:
Cement is hereby excluded from the list of export products subject to duty as provided under Section
515, Title III of the Tariff and Customs Code, as amended.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-five.
